topic: The character death that triggered a national crisis across all of Japan
hook: One anime character died — and Japan went into mourning.
script: One anime character died — and Japan went into mourning. When Maes Hughes was killed in Fullmetal Alchemist, fan grief was so intense that flowers and letters were left at Animerica offices. In Japan, a fictional character's death drove real people into genuine emotional crisis. Therapists noted increased depression among young viewers. A fictional murder caused real psychological distress across an entire country. Follow for the moments anime proved it's more than entertainment.
